name: Matt Hart
bio: I'm Matt, co-owner of Take The Lead Services. Before founding TTLS I was a frontline police officer with Surrey Police, working in response, neighbourhood policing and the Roads Policing Unit. In 2018 I left policing to focus full-time on the business, and on my passion for dog training. I've since trained with leading names including Jens Frank (SWDI), Victoria Stilwell and Louise Wilson (Conservation K9 Consultancy). I qualified as a Scent Instructor and Scent Detection Dog Handler with the WSDA and the UK College of Scent Detection, and have trained and handled operational detection dogs on government contracts across Europe. My two working Cocker Spaniels come on that journey with me: Kizzy, trained in active search, and Breeze, trained in passive and laser-guided search.
